# Droppe

> Droppe is a B2B marketplace for high-quality workwear, safety shoes, and PPE from leading European brands at wholesale pricing.

Droppe connects businesses with top suppliers like New Balance, Blaklader, Fristads, and Portwest, offering bulk purchasing options, safety-certified products, and account management tools for procurement teams. The platform specializes in European workwear and occupational footwear with comprehensive safety standards compliance.

## Key Topics

- Safety shoes
- Workwear
- PPE (Personal Protective Equipment)
- Wholesale pricing
- B2B marketplace
- ESD protection
- Safety standards (S1P, S3L, S1PS)
- Bulk orders
- European brands
- New Balance
- Blaklader
- Fristads GmbH
- Product catalog
- Discount pricing
- Work footwear
